requirements.statement: Produce an evidence-based comparison covering satellite, airborne, and ground-based methane-leak detection and quantification methods for oil and gas infrastructure.
Compare sensitivity, false-positive behavior, weather limitations, and coverage limitations using definitions and evidence appropriate to each method class.
Identify reported validation disagreements, preserve the conflicting evidence, and avoid presenting absence of recorded contradiction as scientific consensus.
Define and disclose evidence-based criteria for selecting the most testable claims before creating the reproducibility-check design.
Design a reproducibility check whose datasets, metrics, baselines, resource envelope, stopping conditions, and tested-versus-not-tested boundary are explicit.

compiler_notes: Requirements are workflow-independent and do not select DAG nodes, workers, datasets, or physical operators.
RequirementIR cannot become canonical until IntentIR fidelity is accepted.
